scope: Bandit 1.9.4 over account_access application source only

review.assessment: The two flagged SQL strings choose a table from a closed literal map or add a fixed predicate; runtime values are bound parameters. No arbitrary user SQL observed.
Reviewed matches are published fictional credentials, a CSS password selector and protocol/status literals. This is not a complete secret scan.
Reviewed subprocess sites use argument arrays without shell execution. Configuration/runtime paths are trusted local operator inputs; same-user OS isolation is not established.
Reviewed suppression avoids leaking diagnostic/provider text or performs best-effort rollback. Unexpected worker failures still lack owner-visible operational health; this remains release work.

limits: Review is internal and manual, not an independent security audit
No claim that the application is vulnerability-free
QA guard scripts were outside this application-only scan
Private mailbox and physical-device acceptance remain incomplete
followup: Build 55 replaces silent worker suppression with fixed-field health; see artifacts/worker-health-080.json for its separate scan and tests.
